scripts.test: npm run test:repo && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:repo: npm run build -w packages/daemon && node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/*.test.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-first-run-references.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-guard.mjs && node scripts/mirror-skills.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-context-packs.mjs --check
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run test -w packages/i18n -w packages/daemon -w packages/cli -w packages/tui
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck:prep && npm run typecheck -w packages/i18n && tsc --noEmit --project packages/daemon/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/tui/tsconfig.json
